Finish your turn? Units with moves remaining will wait until your next turn.
Return to the main menu? Save your game first to keep your latest progress.

Tap your unit, then tap a destination to preview the route. Press Move / attack to move there. To attack, tap a reachable enemy and press Move / attack; you can review weapons and odds before committing.

Tap your selected unit again to deselect it, then drag to explore the map. Zoom + and Zoom − change the scale. Long press a hex for its context menu.

Next unit, Recruit, Undo and End turn act on the current game. Greyed controls are not available yet, and End turn and Quit to menu ask before acting.

The arrow on the left hides the bar and gives the map more space; tap it again to bring the controls back. More holds objectives, saves, unit information, preferences and this help.
